name: Order Confirmation Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of an order confirmation or of an order confirmation amendment.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Order confirmation or order confirmation cancellation instruction or order confirmation amendment has been sent to the next party, eg, the next intermediary.

CPNP.name: Communication Problem Next Party
CPNP.definition: Communication problems with the next party.

COAC.name: Confirmation Accepted
COAC.definition: Order confirmation or order confirmation amendment is accepted.

CREC.name: Confirmation Received
CREC.definition: Order confirmation or order confirmation amendment is received, ie, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.
